Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

Our third-party integration partner needed additional time to complete certification of the component required for your project, and that process ran two weeks beyond the original schedule. As a result, the delivery date has moved to 14 April. Every other part of the build has stayed on track, and our team is continuing work on the remaining items in parallel so we can hold this new date firmly.

To keep things moving smoothly on your end, could you let us know whether 14 April still works with your internal launch or rollout plans? If there's a hard constraint on your side tied to the original date, we want to know now so we can look at options together rather than after the fact.

We'll send a confirmation once certification is finalized, along with an updated project timeline reflecting the new milestones. In the meantime, please reach out if you'd like a call to walk through the details or discuss how this affects any dependent workstreams on your side.
